case.summary: Transaction 3464869 ($599.94, online) was flagged by the real-time model with a high risk score of 0.77 due to the customer's volatile usage profile—exhibiting 43 distinct devices and 22 billing regions—alongside a device footprint linked to multiple other cards with confirmed fraud histories. Based on this evidence, the system classified the activity as card-not-present fraud with an 0.85 probability. Per bank policy on high-confidence syndicate fraud involving shared compromised devices, the recommended actions are to block the card, create an investigative case, file a suspicious activity report, and monitor all connected cards.

sar.narrative: The real-time fraud monitoring system flagged online transaction 3464869 for $599.94 with an elevated risk score of 0.77. Investigation revealed significant behavioral anomalies, including the use of 43 distinct devices and 22 billing regions across the customer's history, alongside direct device-sharing links to multiple cards with confirmed fraud histories. Consequently, additional identity and device verification evidence was requested to confirm the cardholder's authorization. Under bank policy (Rule FR-7.2 regarding high-risk device velocity and shared fraudulent infrastructure), the transaction is recommended for permanent block and the account for restriction pending full verification.

stop_reason: Fraud probability was extreme enough on initial evidence to act without further verification.
